title: ARMv8 Instruction Set Overview
version: PRD03-GENC-010197 issue 15.0, 11 November 2011; Princeton University archive copy

passages.note: The document identifies issue 15.0 as the first non-confidential release. It defines A64 as the instruction set for AArch64 and describes fixed 32-bit instruction encodings with 64-bit general-purpose registers.
